resources.title: Valheim Progression Guide – Early & Mid Game
resources.creator: JP Valheim
resources.noteEs: JP Valheim ordena la progresión recomendada bioma por bioma desde Meadows hasta Mountain, explicando qué gear, qué food y qué buffs traer a cada boss. Referencia para evitar saltar etapas y morir en un swamp con stone gear.
resources.noteEn: JP Valheim lays out the recommended biome-by-biome progression from Meadows to Mountain, explaining what gear, food, and buffs to bring to each boss. A reference to avoid skipping stages and dying in a swamp with stone gear.

resources.title: The Ultimate BOSS GUIDE — Best Secrets, Patterns, & Weaknesses!
resources.creator: EmmaTpotato
resources.noteEs: Resumen denso (7 min) cubriendo los patterns y weaknesses de cada boss. Útil como reference rápida antes de un fight cuando ya jugaste y solo necesitas repasar mecánicas.
resources.noteEn: Dense summary (7 min) covering every boss's patterns and weaknesses. Useful as a quick reference before a fight when you've already played and just need a mechanics refresh.

resources.title: Ultimate Guide To Ashlands Boss In Valheim
resources.creator: FireSpark81
resources.noteEs: FireSpark81 cubre el Fader boss en Ashlands con estrategia para solo y co-op, incluyendo preparación de altar, gear necesario, y cómo manejar las fases del fight con ground spikes y ranged attacks.
resources.noteEn: FireSpark81 covers the Ashlands Fader boss with solo and co-op strategy, including altar preparation, required gear, and how to handle fight phases with ground spikes and ranged attacks.

resources.title: Valheim Boss Battle Fader Combat Guide
resources.creator: Gunny The Gunmage
resources.noteEs: Guía profunda (22 min) del Fader (Ashlands) con análisis frame por frame de los ataques, mejores armas (Nidhogg, Thundering Axes), y posicionamiento óptimo. Para quien va a soloar el boss más duro del juego.
resources.noteEn: Deep guide (22 min) of Fader (Ashlands) with frame-by-frame attack analysis, best weapons (Nidhogg, Thundering Axes), and optimal positioning. For someone going to solo the game's toughest boss.

resources.title: YAGLUTH DOWN!!! - Valheim No Resets Speedrun (Part 3) + DayZ
resources.creator: NickRawcliffe
resources.noteEs: Live stream extendido (6h+) donde NickRawcliffe mata Yagluth bajo regla 'no resets'. Para quien quiere ver execution real de un boss difícil sin cortes editoriales, con context de speedrun.
resources.noteEn: Extended live stream (6h+) where NickRawcliffe kills Yagluth under 'no resets' rules. For someone wanting to see real execution of a tough boss without editorial cuts, with speedrun context.
